reuse.why: Introduces getRangeAmount and routes getScheduledAmount and every site through it, but the sites keep their own missing/number/range ternaries instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range rule now has one definition; the per-site missing ? 0 : number ? value : range dispatch remains copied at four sites (left as it was, not added).

placement.why: The new helper sits in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, and the call sites in forecast, schedules app, template and preview import it.

scope.why: Only the range rule, its call sites, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A future change to the range rule is made once; a change to how missing or approximate amounts are expected would still need edits at each site's dispatch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own dispatch around getRangeAmount rather than calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic newly duplicated; the remaining ternaries are pre-existing and unchanged in shape.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and all five server/shared sites.
